title: Waiting for a mission
caption: I have no active task.
meaning: The panel shows READY and REMOTE START.
next: An operator-authorised rehearsal can begin. Readiness is a display state, not proof that every subsystem passed a pre-flight check.

title: Mission acknowledged
caption: The demonstration has been authorised.
meaning: MISSION APPROVED blinks on a black panel.
next: Show the mission briefing. This is not a real aircraft arming signal.

title: Understand the objective
caption: My task is to survey, compare reports or recover.
meaning: The briefing shows SURVEY, COMPARE or RECOVER with SHARE DATA and KEEP CLEAR.
next: Interpret later observations against the selected objective. The illustration uses the survey briefing.

title: Enter the simulated world
caption: The rehearsal is starting.
meaning: The camera and altitude presentation transition into the flight view.
next: Proceed to the deployment presentation. No motor command is produced by this renderer.

title: Form up
caption: I am moving into my assigned part of the scene.
meaning: DEPLOY and FORM UP accompany the simulated movement.
next: Begin the observation phase. The moving picture alone does not establish a computed flight plan.

title: Look for an observation
caption: I am looking for something relevant to the task.
meaning: A scanning overlay marks the observation phase.
next: Keep searching, or enter SEEN when the scenario presents a candidate observation.

title: Continue observing
caption: I am maintaining an observation role.
meaning: LOITER is accompanied by a GRID or ORBIT caption.
next: Continue observing, respond to a review request, or move into the recovery branch when the scenario requires it.

title: A candidate observation
caption: I have noticed something; I have not established what it means.
meaning: A bracket highlights an observation in the scene.
next: Share a report or seek a check. A bracket is not a confidence score or proof of correct identification.

title: Offer a report
caption: Another node may benefit from what I observed.
meaning: SHARE normally shows REPORT. During a communication event, the footer can show TX plus the peer label.
next: A receiver can consider the report alongside its own observation. The current scripted flash does not itself deliver a real payload.

title: Seek corroboration
caption: I need to compare this report with independent evidence.
meaning: CHECK and VERIFY identify a review state; an RX footer can temporarily replace VERIFY.
next: Continue observation if evidence is incomplete; record agreement or disagreement in an instrumented experiment. Do not equate receipt with agreement.

title: Keep uncertainty visible
caption: The available reports do not yet agree.
meaning: DOUBT, a contrasting reticle and the 2 CLAIMS caption show a conflict presentation.
next: Request another check, keep the observation unresolved, or resume the survey. Two claims can repeat the same source and are not necessarily independent.

title: Observation no longer available
caption: I cannot currently maintain this observation.
meaning: LOST is accompanied by SEARCH.
next: Revisit the observation task or record that the evidence is unavailable. It does not mean that the network link has failed.

title: Wait for coordination
caption: I am waiting for the next task decision.
meaning: HOLD and HQ WAIT distinguish waiting from active observation.
next: Continue when the scenario supplies the next instruction. A waiting panel is not evidence that a model is currently thinking.

title: Announce a shared observation
caption: There is a symbolic beacon for the group to review.
meaning: ALERT shows BEACON P1. In the coordination fixture, its source transmits to the other panels.
next: Move into the fixture's review sequence. P1 is a scripted label, not an inferred urgency or confidence value.

title: Display the selected task order
caption: The rehearsal is considering P1 first.
meaning: PRIORITY displays P1 FIRST.
next: The fixture presents candidate volunteers. This display does not implement a learned priority calculation.

title: Offer to inspect
caption: I am volunteering for this observation task.
meaning: CLAIM displays CLAIM P1. Two predetermined participants send their claims separately to the source in the preview fixture.
next: Wait for the assignment presentation. A claim is an offer, not ownership or evidence that the node is best placed.

title: Show the observation owner
caption: I have the observation role for this rehearsal.
meaning: ASSIGN displays OWNER and a node label.
next: The chosen observer continues observing. The fixture chooses the owner deterministically; no bidding optimisation is demonstrated.

title: Avoid duplicate ownership
caption: Another node owns this observation task.
meaning: YIELD displays the same OWNER label as the assignment.
next: Other participants can return to their survey roles. This is a presentation of coordination, not proof of distributed consensus.

title: Return to the base
caption: This rehearsal is moving into recovery.
meaning: R2B and HOME identify the return presentation.
next: Proceed toward LAND. The example does not specify a real aircraft's reserve threshold or navigation policy.

title: Finish simulated flight
caption: I am completing the return sequence.
meaning: The camera/altitude presentation descends into the home view.
next: Show CHARGE or STANDBY according to the scripted outcome.

title: Recharge presentation
caption: I am unavailable while the demonstration shows replenishment.
meaning: CHARGE includes an animated battery indicator.
next: Return to standby when the sequence advances. The indicator is simulated, not a measured charging current.

title: Ready for the next role
caption: I am waiting at the base.
meaning: STANDBY presents the parked state.
next: Remain available for a subsequent authorised rehearsal.

title: Stale view or missing link
caption: I do not have a fresh view to rely on.
meaning: NOLINK freezes the camera presentation and shows an AGE caption.
next: Treat the represented information as stale. In this scripted mode, AGE is scene time rather than measured packet latency.

title: Simulated energy exhausted
caption: The rehearsal has reached an energy failure state.
meaning: The battery indicator falls and the view dims.
next: Record the simulated failure outcome. This is not a physical battery measurement or an instruction for aircraft recovery.

title: Simulated failure outcome
caption: This run has ended in a simulated failure.
meaning: The view rolls toward the ground, then later shows signal loss.
next: Preserve the event trace for review. The thumbnail shows an early phase of the display sequence, not a photograph or real crash report.
